title: WebSailor-V2: Bridging the Chasm to Proprietary Agents via Synthetic Data and Scalable Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Kuan Li, Zhongwang Zhang, Huifeng Yin, Rui Ye, Yida Zhao, Liwen Zhang, Litu Ou, Ding-Chu Zhang, Xixi Wu, Xinmiao Yu, Jialong Wu, Xinyu Wang, Zile Qiao, Zhen Zhang, Yong Jiang, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang, Zhi-Qin John Xu, Shuai Wang, Minhao Cheng, Jingren Zhou
paper_type_zh: 信息检索 agent 的合成数据构造与双环境 SFT/RL 方法
best_for_zh: 研究 web-agent 轨迹、合成 QA、双环境 agentic RL、release-scale 审计与失败轨迹保留的读者
one_line: WebSailor-V2 reports 30K-plus synthetic instruction pairs, rejection-sampled ReAct SFT, and on-policy RL across offline-Wikipedia and managed live-web environments, but releases no V2 data, code, verifier, or complete trajectories.
WebSailor-V2 报告了 3 万余条合成 instruction pair、经 rejection sampling 获得的 ReAct SFT 轨迹，以及跨离线 Wikipedia 与受管真实网络环境的 on-policy RL，但没有公开 V2 数据、代码、verifier 或完整成败轨迹。
why: It is a strong construction-recipe case for how topology-aware web tasks, successful tool-use traces, and dual-environment RL can be coupled, while sharply demonstrating why paper scale, public release scale, reward reproducibility, V1/V2 provenance, and failure retention must be audited independently.
inclusion_reason: WebSailor-V2 is directly relevant because it specifies a high-scale path from dense web-derived QA construction to complete ReAct supervision and on-policy agent RL across simulated and live environments. Its value to this atlas is equally the audit boundary: a paper-reported 30K-plus instruction-pair corpus and complete-episode training recipe coexist with a documentation-only V2 release, an undisclosed reward contract, and no public successful or failed trajectory archive.

title: Problem
问题
html:
WebSailor-V2 addresses two linked bottlenecks in training deep information-seeking agents: task generators that expose too narrow a range of uncertainty, and live-web reinforcement-learning systems whose latency, failures, and changing outputs make large-scale rollout collection unstable. The stable bibliographic boundary is the ICLR 2026 Poster record; arXiv:2509.13305v1 was submitted on 16 September 2025, while the final OpenReview version adds authors and a dataset-statistics section.

The paper uses three linked data objects. SailorFog-QA-V2 supplies synthetic question-answer instruction pairs sampled from dense web-derived graphs. Unspecified high-performing open-source models solve those tasks, and rejection sampling selects successful ReAct episodes for SFT. The current policy then generates complete ReAct rollouts in an offline-Wikipedia simulator or a managed live-web environment, with one terminal scalar reward per episode (Paper §§2–4; Appendix B).

This is an environment_agent_trajectory_data paper because the training object includes a task, thought/action/observation history, tool-mediated environment state, terminal answer, and trajectory-level reward. It is not a public dataset or replayable-environment release: the final paper reports more than 30,000 SailorFog-QA-V2 instruction-tuning pairs, but the official V2 directory contains only a README and two images, with no V2 records, trajectories, training code, simulator, reward implementation, or model link.

The Card therefore treats WebSailor-V2 as a construction and audit reference. It can reach L4 descriptive depth because the paper specifies the high-level pipeline and tools, but canonical metadata remains partial and L3_summary_ready: the reward predicate, complete corpus, successful and failed rollout populations, record-level lineage, and replay stack are unavailable.

WebSailor-V2 针对深度信息检索 agent 训练中的两个相关瓶颈：一是任务生成器覆盖的不确定性类型过窄，二是真实网络 RL 的延迟、失败和输出漂移使大规模 rollout 收集不稳定。稳定的书目信息边界是 ICLR 2026 Poster；arXiv:2509.13305v1 于 2025 年 9 月 16 日提交，最终 OpenReview 版本增加了作者和数据统计小节。

论文使用三个相互关联的数据对象。SailorFog-QA-V2 从稠密的网络事实图中采样合成 question-answer instruction pair；未具名的高性能开源模型求解这些任务，并通过 rejection sampling 选出成功 ReAct episode 用于 SFT；当前策略随后在离线 Wikipedia 模拟器或受管真实网络环境中生成完整 ReAct rollout，每个 episode 获得一个 terminal scalar reward（论文 §§2–4；Appendix B）。

该工作属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为训练对象包含 task、thought/action/observation 历史、工具介导的环境状态、terminal answer 和 trajectory-level reward。它并不是公开数据集或可 replay 环境：最终稿报告 SailorFog-QA-V2 有 3 万余条 instruction-tuning pair，但 V2 官方目录只有 README 和两张图片，没有 V2 记录、轨迹、训练代码、模拟器、reward 实现或模型链接。

因此，本 Card 将 WebSailor-V2 定位为构造与审计参考。论文对总体 pipeline 和工具的说明足以支持 L4 深度的 Card，但 canonical metadata 仍应保持 partial 和 L3_summary_ready：reward predicate、完整 corpus、成功与失败 rollout 总体、逐条 lineage 和 replay stack 均不可用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
WebSailor-V2's central move is to couple topology-aware synthetic task generation with a simulator-to-live-web post-training loop. V2 expands a seed-centered graph with deliberately dense and cyclic links, samples connected subgraphs by random walk, checks structural non-isomorphism with Weisfeiler-Leman, and distributes question focus across orbit-node roles. The final paper names semantic ambiguity, plausible distractor noise, and structural constraints over bridges or cut vertices as uncertainty mechanisms (Paper §§3.1–3.4).

The resulting object is not merely a QA row. An SFT example is a successful ReAct solution containing repeated thought, action, and observation turns plus a final answer. An RL example is a current-policy episode in the same interaction format, sampled either against offline Wikipedia tools or a managed live tool service. Search, Visit, Google Scholar, Python interpreter, and Final Answer define the action surface (Paper §2; Appendix B).

The feedback contract is the largest unresolved boundary. The tailored GRPO objective uses one episode reward R_i and a leave-one-out group-relative advantage, but the paper never defines how R_i is computed. It does not name a rule, judge, answer-equivalence test, or calibration protocol. Benchmark accuracy uses LLM judges, but that does not prove the training reward uses the same mechanism. The Card therefore records verification_contract: unknown and does not broaden training use to RLVR.

Relative to WebSailor-V1, V2 changes graph density and sampling, broadens uncertainty types, switches from a 72B dense model to a 30B-A3B MoE, expands context from 32k to 128k and ReAct iterations to 100, and adds the offline/live dual environment. V1's public 20-row QA sample, inference code, and WebSailor checkpoints remain V1 artifacts; they cannot fill V2's release gaps.

WebSailor-V2 的核心变化，是把 topology-aware 合成任务生成与 simulator-to-live-web post-training loop 结合起来。V2 围绕 seed entity 扩展刻意稠密且含环的连接，用 random walk 采样 connected subgraph，通过 Weisfeiler-Leman 检查结构非同构，并让问题焦点分布到不同 orbit-node 角色。最终稿明确列出 semantic ambiguity、可信 distractor noise，以及针对 bridge 或 cut vertex 的 structural constraint 三类不确定性机制（论文 §§3.1–3.4）。

所得对象不只是 QA 行。SFT 样本是一个成功 ReAct 解答，包含反复出现的 thought、action、observation 和 final answer；RL 样本则是当前策略按相同交互格式生成的 episode，环境为离线 Wikipedia 工具或受管真实工具服务。Search、Visit、Google Scholar、Python interpreter 和 Final Answer 共同定义 action surface（论文 §2；Appendix B）。

反馈契约是最大的未决边界。定制 GRPO 目标使用每条 episode 的 reward R_i 和 leave-one-out group-relative advantage，但论文没有定义 R_i 的计算方式，也没有给出 rule、judge、答案等价测试或校准方案。benchmark accuracy 使用 LLM judge，不等于训练 reward 也使用同一机制。因此 Card 记录 verification_contract: unknown，且不把 training_use 扩大到 RLVR。

相对 WebSailor-V1，V2 改变了图密度和采样方式，扩展了不确定性类型，从 72B dense model 换为 30B-A3B MoE，把 context 从 32k 提高到 128k、ReAct 上限提高到 100，并增加离线/真实双环境。V1 的 20 行 QA 样例、推理代码和 WebSailor checkpoint 都是 V1 artifact，不能用来填补 V2 的发布缺口。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Graph collection. Begin with seed entities, use web tools to find related entities and facts, deliberately connect existing nodes to make components denser and cyclic, and internally preserve discovery queries, source URLs, and entity statistics. Seed lists, crawl dates, source manifests, and generator models are undisclosed (Paper §3.1).
  2. Subgraph and QA synthesis. Run random walks to extract connected subgraphs, use Weisfeiler-Leman to check non-isomorphism, balance focus across orbit-node roles, then generate questions with semantic ambiguity, distractors, or structural constraints. The final paper reports more than 30,000 instruction-tuning pairs; exact count, schema, split, duplicates, and record-level provenance are unknown (§§3.2–3.4).
  3. SFT trajectory collection. Unspecified high-performing open-source models solve generated tasks. Rejection sampling keeps successful trajectories, but candidate count, acceptance rule, retry budget, decoding, and failure retention are not reported. Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 receives the cold-start SFT (§4.1).
  4. Dual environments. Adapt the generator to an offline Wikipedia corpus for simulation train/test tasks and rapid algorithm iteration. For final live-web training, route multiple search providers, page parsers, and Python through a scheduling layer with QPS limits, caching, retries, degradation, and backups (§4.2).
  5. On-policy RL. Generate current-policy episode groups and optimize a tailored GRPO objective with token-level policy gradients and leave-one-out advantages. Selectively omit some negative trajectories, including overlength runs without Final Answer; do not use dynamic sampling. R_i, group size, clipping values, and the complete exclusion rule are unknown (§4.2).
  6. Training configuration. Megatron SFT uses batch 64, learning rate 5e-6 to 1e-10, cosine decay, and weight decay 0.1. rLLM RL uses batch 128, learning rate 1e-6, temperature 1.0, and top-p 1.0. Inference allows 128k context and up to 100 ReAct rounds (Appendix B; §5.4).

Reproduction additionally requires the exact SailorFog-QA/V2/IterBench stage mixture, graph and prompt lineage, reward implementation, Wikipedia snapshot, live provider and parser versions, cache and retry records, sandbox image, dependency commits, seeds, and all retained/excluded rollouts. None are released by the V2 project directory.

可重建的 pipeline 如下：

  1. 图收集。 从 seed entity 出发，用网络工具寻找相关实体和事实，主动连接已有节点以构造更稠密、含环的 component，并在内部保留 discovery query、source URL 和 entity statistic。seed list、crawl date、source manifest 和生成模型均未披露（论文 §3.1）。
  2. 子图与 QA 合成。 用 random walk 提取 connected subgraph，以 Weisfeiler-Leman 检查非同构，平衡不同 orbit-node 角色的提问焦点，再用 semantic ambiguity、distractor 或 structural constraint 生成问题。最终稿报告 3 万余条 instruction-tuning pair；确切数量、schema、split、重复项和逐条 provenance 未知（§§3.2–3.4）。
  3. SFT 轨迹收集。 未具名的高性能开源模型求解合成任务，rejection sampling 保留成功轨迹；candidate 数、接受规则、retry budget、decoding 和失败轨迹保留情况均未报告。Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 接受 cold-start SFT（§4.1）。
  4. 双环境。 将生成器适配到离线 Wikipedia corpus，构造 simulation train/test task 并快速迭代算法；最终真实网络训练则通过调度层管理多个搜索源、页面 parser 和 Python，提供 QPS 限制、cache、retry、degradation 和 backup（§4.2）。
  5. On-policy RL。 生成当前策略的 episode group，用 token-level policy gradient 和 leave-one-out advantage 优化定制 GRPO。部分 negative trajectory 被排除，例如超长且没有 Final Answer 的 run；不使用 dynamic sampling。R_i、group size、clip 值和完整排除规则未知（§4.2）。
  6. 训练配置。 Megatron SFT 使用 batch 64、learning rate 从 5e-6 衰减到 1e-10、cosine decay、weight decay 0.1；rLLM RL 使用 batch 128、learning rate 1e-6、temperature 1.0、top-p 1.0。推理允许 128k context 和最多 100 轮 ReAct（Appendix B；§5.4）。

复现还需要 SailorFog-QA/V2/IterBench 的阶段混合比例、graph/prompt lineage、reward 实现、Wikipedia snapshot、真实 provider/parser 版本、cache/retry 记录、sandbox image、dependency commit、seed，以及全部保留/排除 rollout。V2 项目目录没有发布这些内容。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 1 evaluates the SFT and RL checkpoints on BrowseComp-EN, BrowseComp-ZH, xbench-DeepSearch, GAIA, and HLE. The SFT model reports 24.4, 28.3, 61.7, 66.0, and 23.9; the RL model reports 35.3, 44.1, 73.7, 74.1, and 30.6. These are author-reported pass@1-style results under the paper's tool and judge setup, not independent reproductions (Table 1; §5.1).

The within-model comparison gives the clearest supported effect: RL adds 10.9 points on BrowseComp-EN, 15.8 on BrowseComp-ZH, 12.0 on xbench-DeepSearch, 8.1 on GAIA, and 6.7 on HLE over the listed SFT checkpoint. Figure 6 further reports smaller pass@3 than pass@1 gains on simpler xbench/GAIA tasks, while both metrics rise more on BrowseComp; this is an interpretation of sampling behavior, not proof of a new reasoning capability (§5.4, Figure 6).

For scale and budget, final-paper §3.4 reports more than 30,000 SailorFog-QA-V2 instruction-tuning pairs, graph components averaging about 30 nodes and degree 2.5, and structural coverage from chains to cycles and dense clusters. Section 5.4 raises context from V1's 32k to 128k and the maximum ReAct rounds to 100; nearly 90% of correctly solved instances finish within 64k. These figures do not disclose complete-trajectory count, rollout attempts, API calls, or compute.

The main evidence limitations are material. The paper reports no training-seed variance, no ablation isolating the 30K-plus corpus from the V1 SailorFog-QA and IterBench mixture, no public reward audit, no decontamination analysis, and no independent simulator-to-live transfer reproduction. The official V2 tree remained exactly README plus two images from the 2025-09-17 release commit through the inspected 2026-02-27 commit, so experimental scale is not public release scale.

Table 1 在 BrowseComp-EN、BrowseComp-ZH、xbench-DeepSearch、GAIA 和 HLE 上评估 SFT 与 RL checkpoint。SFT 模型依次报告 24.4、28.3、61.7、66.0、23.9；RL 模型依次报告 35.3、44.1、73.7、74.1、30.6。这些是论文工具与 judge 设置下由作者报告的 pass@1 风格结果，并非独立复现（Table 1；§5.1）。

同一模型内部对比提供了最直接的支持：相对所列 SFT checkpoint，RL 在 BrowseComp-EN、BrowseComp-ZH、xbench-DeepSearch、GAIA 和 HLE 上分别增加 10.9、15.8、12.0、8.1 和 6.7 分。Figure 6 还报告，较简单的 xbench/GAIA 上 pass@3 增幅小于 pass@1，而 BrowseComp 上两者都更明显上升；这是对 sampling behavior 的解释，不是新 reasoning capability 的证明（§5.4，Figure 6）。

关于规模与预算，最终稿 §3.4 报告 SailorFog-QA-V2 有 3 万余条 instruction-tuning pair，graph component 平均约 30 个节点、平均 degree 2.5，结构覆盖 chain、cycle 和 dense cluster。§5.4 将 context 从 V1 的 32k 提高到 128k，把最大 ReAct 轮数提高到 100；近 90% 的正确样例在 64k 内完成。这些数字并没有给出完整轨迹数、rollout 尝试数、API 调用数或计算量。

证据限制很实质：论文没有 training-seed 方差，没有把 3 万余条 V2 corpus 与 V1 SailorFog-QA、IterBench 混合分离的 ablation，没有公开 reward audit、decontamination 分析或独立 simulator-to-live transfer 复现。V2 官方树从 2025-09-17 发布 commit 到检查的 2026-02-27 commit 始终只有 README 和两张图片，因此实验规模不等于公开发布规模。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest prior work is WebSailor-V1 rather than generic chain-of-thought distillation. V1 already uses web-derived graph tasks, ReAct trajectories, rejection-style cold start, and agentic RL. V2's data-side change is denser cyclic graph construction, random-walk extraction in place of attempted exhaustive enumeration, orbit-aware QA focus, and uncertainty definitions beyond obfuscation. The final paper makes those changes concrete with semantic ambiguity, distractor noise, structural constraints, and 30K-plus instruction pairs (§§3.1–3.4).

The environment-side change is the dual simulator/live architecture. Offline Wikipedia enables fast and controllable algorithm tests; the managed live layer tries to suppress real API variance through caching, retries, QPS limits, degradation, and backups. This is an engineering integration, not a released general-purpose environment, because code, snapshots, caches, and replay fixtures are absent (§4.2).

The optimizer is a tailored GRPO rather than a wholly new learning principle. Strict on-policy sampling, token-level gradients, leave-one-out advantages, selective negative exclusion, and large batches/groups are assembled for expensive agent episodes. The paper explicitly argues that data and environment stability matter more than fine algorithm differences. Because R_i is undefined and group size is unknown, the optimizer contribution cannot be fully reconstructed.

For reasoning-data research, the directional novelty is the coupling of graph topology, uncertainty type, trajectory selection, and environment stability. Reuse should test which gain comes from V2 task structure, SFT trace quality, expanded context, the base-model change, or RL—and should never attribute V1 public artifacts to V2 without explicit lineage.

最接近的 prior work 是 WebSailor-V1，而不是通用 chain-of-thought distillation。V1 已经使用网络事实图任务、ReAct trajectory、rejection-style cold start 和 agentic RL。V2 在数据侧的变化是更稠密的含环图、用 random walk 替代尝试穷举子图、按 orbit 分配 QA 焦点，以及超越 obfuscation 的不确定性定义。最终稿用 semantic ambiguity、distractor noise、structural constraint 和 3 万余条 instruction pair 使这些变化具体化（§§3.1–3.4）。

环境侧的变化是 simulator/live 双环境架构。离线 Wikipedia 支持快速、可控的算法实验；受管真实网络层则用 cache、retry、QPS 限制、degradation 和 backup 抑制真实 API 方差。这是工程整合，不是已发布的通用 environment，因为代码、snapshot、cache 和 replay fixture 均缺失（§4.2）。

优化器是定制 GRPO，并非全新的学习原理。strict on-policy sampling、token-level gradient、leave-one-out advantage、选择性排除 negative sample，以及大 batch/group 被组合用于昂贵的 agent episode。论文明确认为数据和环境稳定性比细小算法差别更重要。由于 R_i 未定义、group size 未知，该优化贡献无法完整重建。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向性新意是把 graph topology、uncertainty type、trajectory selection 和 environment stability 耦合起来。复用时应分别检验 V2 任务结构、SFT 轨迹质量、context 扩大、base-model 变化和 RL 的贡献；没有明确 lineage 时，绝不能把 V1 公开 artifact 归到 V2。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Unknown reward contract. The paper optimizes a scalar R_i but does not disclose its components, verifier, answer-equivalence rule, scale, calibration, or code. Curator inference: reward hacking and alternative-valid-answer false negatives cannot be evaluated from public evidence.
  • Selective failure removal. SFT uses rejection sampling, and RL removes some overlength no-answer negatives from the loss. Candidate attempts, exclusion counts, and retention policy are unknown, creating survivor and observability bias.
  • No complete trajectories. The V2 directory contains only documentation and images. It releases neither successful SFT trajectories nor correct, incorrect, timed-out, retried, tool-failed, or overlength RL episodes.
  • Environment drift. Google, Jina, Google Scholar, summary-model outputs, caches, backups, and page contents vary over time. No Wikipedia snapshot, service version, cache manifest, retry log, sandbox image, or replay fixture is public.
  • Mixture ambiguity. §4.1 says SFT data is entirely synthetic from SailorFog-QA-V2, while §5.1 lists SailorFog-QA, SailorFog-QA-V2, and IterBench as training data. Stage-level counts and weights are not disclosed.
  • Contamination risk. The pipeline mines live-web facts and is evaluated on six public benchmarks, but there is no exact, semantic, entity, source-page, temporal, or tool-observation overlap audit. The reported direct BrowseComp-test training experiment is not decontamination.
  • Scale ambiguity. More than 30,000 refers to instruction-tuning pairs, not a verified count of complete SFT or RL trajectories. Record schema, exact count, splits, duplicates, languages, domains, and checksums are unavailable.
  • Rights and privacy. Paper and repository licenses do not establish rights for unreleased graph records, trajectories, Wikipedia snapshots, cached web content, or tool observations. No privacy, robots-policy, source-exclusion, or takedown procedure is disclosed.
  • Version confusion. V1 has code, a 20-row QA sample, and public WebSailor models; V2 does not. Treating V1 artifacts or the separately released Tongyi-DeepResearch model as V2 without explicit linkage would be misattribution.
  • Experimental scope. Results are author-reported under one tool stack, without training-seed variance, independent reproduction, complete compute accounting, or a controlled decomposition of data, model, context, environment, and RL changes.

• Reward 契约未知。 论文优化 scalar R_i，但没有披露组成、verifier、答案等价规则、尺度、校准或代码。Curator inference：公开证据不足以评估 reward hacking 和对替代有效答案的 false negative。
  • 选择性移除失败。 SFT 使用 rejection sampling，RL 又从 loss 中排除部分超长且无答案的 negative。candidate 尝试数、排除计数和保留政策未知，会造成 survivor bias 和 observability bias。
  • 没有完整轨迹。 V2 目录只有文档和图片，既不发布成功 SFT trajectory，也不发布正确、错误、timeout、retry、tool-failure 或 overlength RL episode。
  • 环境漂移。 Google、Jina、Google Scholar、summary model 输出、cache、backup 和页面内容会随时间变化。没有公开 Wikipedia snapshot、服务版本、cache manifest、retry log、sandbox image 或 replay fixture。
  • 混合比例不清。 §4.1 说 SFT 数据全部由 SailorFog-QA-V2 合成，而 §5.1 又把 SailorFog-QA、SailorFog-QA-V2 和 IterBench 列为 training data。各阶段计数和权重未披露。
  • 污染风险。 pipeline 从真实网络采集事实，并在六个公开 benchmark 上评估，但没有 exact、semantic、entity、source-page、temporal 或 tool-observation overlap audit。直接在 BrowseComp test 上训练的实验也不是 decontamination。
  • 规模歧义。 3 万余条指 instruction-tuning pair，而不是经验证的完整 SFT/RL trajectory 数。record schema、确切数量、split、duplicate、语言、领域和 checksum 均不可用。
  • 权利与隐私。 论文和仓库许可证不能自动覆盖未发布 graph record、trajectory、Wikipedia snapshot、cached web content 或 tool observation。论文未披露 privacy、robots-policy、source exclusion 或 takedown 程序。
  • 版本混淆。 V1 有代码、20 行 QA 样例和公开 WebSailor 模型，V2 没有。没有明确链接时，把 V1 artifact 或另行发布的 Tongyi-DeepResearch 模型当作 V2 都是 misattribution。
  • 实验范围。 结果由作者在一套工具栈上报告，没有 training-seed 方差、独立复现、完整计算成本，亦没有把数据、模型、context、环境和 RL 变化分解的受控实验。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For dataset builders, the paper provides a concrete design hypothesis: make web-task difficulty structural rather than merely lexical. Dense cyclic graphs, random-walk subgraphs, orbit-balanced question focus, ambiguity, distractors, and cut-edge constraints can be implemented as separate fields and ablated. A responsible implementation should also release source URLs, crawl times, prompts, generator revisions, record IDs, splits, duplicates, rejected candidates, and data-specific rights.

For agent-training researchers, the supported uses are full-episode SFT and on-policy agent training. The paper does not support preference learning, process-reward-model training, or training reuse of a public V2 corpus. Baselines should compare V1 versus V2 topology at a fixed base model and budget; simulator-only versus live-only versus staged training; all negatives versus selective exclusion; and 32k/100? No—32k versus 128k context while separately fixing the maximum action budget.

For verifier researchers, the missing R_i definition is itself an audit target. Reimplementations should compare exact match, calibrated semantic equivalence, multi-judge consensus, citation-grounded verification, and human adjudication; publish disagreements and alternative-valid-answer cases; and keep format, answer, evidence, and tool-failure signals separate.

For release auditors, track at least six quantities independently: generated QA pairs, SFT rollout attempts, accepted SFT trajectories, RL prompts, all RL rollouts, and public records. Also record every incorrect, overlength, timeout, retry, API failure, and exclusion. The safe reuse class today is reading and audit reference only; training reuse is blocked by absent V2 data, trajectories, verifier, code, lineage, replay stack, and data-specific license.

对 dataset builder，论文给出一个具体设计假设：web task 的难度应来自结构，而不只是词面。可以把 dense cyclic graph、random-walk subgraph、orbit-balanced question focus、ambiguity、distractor 和 cut-edge constraint 实现为独立字段并做 ablation。负责任的实现还应发布 source URL、crawl time、prompt、generator revision、record ID、split、duplicate、rejected candidate 和数据专用权利条款。

对 agent-training 研究者，有证据支持的用途是 full-episode SFT 和 on-policy agent training。论文不支持 preference learning、process reward model 训练，也不支持复用一个公开 V2 corpus 来训练。baseline 应在固定 base model 和预算下比较 V1/V2 topology，比较 simulator-only、live-only 和 staged training，比较保留全部 negative 与选择性排除，并把 32k/128k context 与最大 action budget 分开控制。

对 verifier 研究者，缺失的 R_i 定义本身就是审计目标。复现实验应比较 exact match、校准后的 semantic equivalence、多 judge 共识、citation-grounded verification 和人工 adjudication；发布 disagreement 与 alternative-valid-answer case；并把 format、answer、evidence 和 tool-failure 信号分开。

对 release auditor，至少要分别记录六个数量：生成 QA pair、SFT rollout 尝试、接受的 SFT trajectory、RL prompt、全部 RL rollout 和公开 record；还要记录每个错误、overlength、timeout、retry、API failure 和 exclusion。当前安全复用等级是仅作阅读与审计参考；V2 数据、轨迹、verifier、代码、lineage、replay stack 和数据专用许可证缺失，阻断训练复用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read final-paper §§3.1–3.4 first. The 30K-plus number is for SailorFog-QA-V2 instruction-tuning pairs; do not silently convert it into a complete-trajectory count.
  • Read §4.1 for the SFT object: unspecified open-source solvers, successful ReAct trajectories, rejection sampling, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, and 128k context. Teacher identity and retained/rejected counts remain unknown.
  • Read §4.2 and Equation 2 together. The optimizer is described, but the terminal reward R_i is not. Selective negative exclusion therefore cannot be audited from the objective alone.
  • Use Table 1 and Figure 6 for SFT-to-RL gains; use Figure 5 for context/action-budget scaling. Keep author-reported benchmark performance separate from independent evidence.
  • Keep four release surfaces distinct: arXiv v1, final ICLR/OpenReview paper, the documentation-only V2 directory, and the richer V1 directory/model collection. Only explicit provenance permits cross-version attribution.
  • Read alongside websailor-2025 and webdancer-2025, but do not use either paper to backfill V2 unknowns. Prioritize reward correctness, the stage-specific SailorFog-QA/V2/IterBench mixture, full success/failure retention, benchmark overlap, environment versioning, and data/trajectory rights.

• 先读最终稿 §§3.1–3.4。3 万余条指 SailorFog-QA-V2 instruction-tuning pair，不能把它无声地改写成完整 trajectory 数。
  • §4.1 定义 SFT 对象：未具名的开源 solver、成功 ReAct trajectory、rejection sampling、Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 和 128k context。teacher 身份及保留/拒绝数量仍未知。
  • §4.2 要与 Equation 2 一起读。优化器有说明，但 terminal reward R_i 没有定义，因此不能只靠目标函数审计选择性排除 negative 的影响。
  • SFT 到 RL 的增益看 Table 1 和 Figure 6；context/action budget scaling 看 Figure 5。作者报告的 benchmark performance 与独立证据要分开。
  • 必须区分四个发布面：arXiv v1、最终 ICLR/OpenReview 论文、只有文档的 V2 目录，以及更丰富的 V1 目录/模型 collection。只有明确 provenance 才允许跨版本归因。
  • 建议与前作 websailor-2025 及相邻的 webdancer-2025 对读，但不能用它们填补 V2 unknown。应优先核验 reward correctness、SailorFog-QA/V2/IterBench 的阶段混合、完整成功/失败保留、benchmark overlap、环境版本化，以及数据/轨迹权利。

value.html: SailorFog-QA-V2 starts from seed entities and uses web tools to expand a dense graph of real-internet facts. V2 deliberately adds cyclic connections, preserves discovery queries and source URLs internally, and stores entity statistics. Random walks extract connected subgraphs; the Weisfeiler-Leman algorithm verifies non-isomorphism; orbit-node analysis distributes QA focus across structural roles. Final-paper uncertainty types include semantic ambiguity, plausible distractor noise, and structural constraints targeting bridges or cut vertices. value.html: Megatron is used for SFT with batch size 64, learning rate 5e-6 decaying to 1e-10 after warmup, cosine decay, and weight decay 0.1. rLLM is used for a tailored GRPO RL objective with strict on-policy sampling, token-level policy gradients, leave-one-out advantage estimation, asymmetric clipping notation, batch size 128, and learning rate 1e-6. Clip bounds and group size are unknown.

value_zh.html: SFT 使用 Megatron，batch size 64，学习率 5e-6 在 warmup 后衰减至 1e-10，余弦衰减，以及 weight decay 0.1。rLLM 用于带严格在策略采样、token 级策略梯度、leave-one-out 优势估计、非对称裁剪记号、batch size 128 与学习率 1e-6 的定制 GRPO RL 目标。Clip 边界与 group size 未知。

value.html: More than 30,000 high-quality SailorFog-QA-V2 instruction-tuning pairs in the final ICLR paper. Connected components average approximately 30 nodes and average degree 2.5. The count of complete SFT trajectories, RL task prompts, simulator records, rollout episodes, and retained failure cases is unknown.

value_zh.html: 最终 ICLR 论文中超过 30,000 对高质量 SailorFog-QA-V2 指令微调对。连通分量平均约 30 个节点，平均度 2.5。完整 SFT 轨迹、RL 任务提示、模拟器记录、rollout episodes 与保留失败情形的计数未知。

value.html: SailorFog-QA-V2 combines real-web graph facts, synthetic uncertainty-rich QA, open-source-model solution trajectories, and on-policy simulator/live-web rollouts. The experiment section additionally lists V1 SailorFog-QA and IterBench. Source proportions, language/domain mix, source URLs, crawl dates, record-level mixture tags, and stage-specific allocations are not released.

value.html: The paper mentions dedicated training and testing data for the offline Wikipedia simulator but gives no counts, split rule, stable IDs, or manifests. No public train/dev/test split exists for the reported 30K-plus V2 pairs or trajectory populations.

items: The training reward R_i is undefined beyond being a terminal scalar, so answer equivalence, alternative-valid-answer handling, reward hacking, and false-positive/false-negative rates cannot be audited.

Benchmark accuracy uses LLM judges, but judge models, snapshots, prompts, repetitions, calibration, human agreement, and robustness are not fully disclosed; this must not be conflated with the RL verifier.
Live search, Jina retrieval, summary-model compression, caching, retries, degradation, and backup sources can change observations and rewards across time even for nominally identical actions.
Selective negative exclusion can hide overlength or non-answering failure modes and changes the effective training distribution without a public exclusion ledger.
The final paper reports a 30K-plus pair scale without a public manifest, so duplicate, source-overlap, contamination, and per-record provenance claims cannot be independently checked.
训练奖励 R_i 除作为终态标量外未定义，因此答案等价、备选有效答案处理、奖励劫持与假阳性/假阴性率无法审计。
基准准确率使用 LLM 评审，但评审模型、snapshots、提示、重复、校准、人类一致性与稳健性未完全披露；不得将其与 RL 验证器混为一谈。
实时搜索、Jina 检索、摘要模型压缩、缓存、重试、降级与备份来源可随时间改变观察与奖励，即使名义上动作相同。
选择性负例排除可掩盖超长或不作答失败模式，并在无公开排除账本的情况下改变有效训练分布。
终稿报告 30K-plus 对规模而无公开清单，因此重复、来源重叠、污染与逐记录出处主张无法独立检查。
External API latency, failure, and inconsistent returns can contaminate trajectories.
Unfiltered negative trajectories can destabilize RL and cause format collapse.
Some trajectories exceed the length limit without producing a final answer.
Rewards are sparse enough that a weak pre-SFT policy may rarely obtain positive feedback.
Live-web observations are non-stationary and prevent deterministic replay.
Report-writing style is less optimized than information retrieval and synthesis.
外部 API 延迟、失败与不一致返回可污染轨迹。
未过滤负轨迹可使 RL 不稳定并导致格式崩溃。
一些轨迹超出长度限制而未产生最终答案。
奖励足够稀疏，弱 pre-SFT 策略可能很少获得正反馈。
实时网页观察非平稳，并阻止确定性回放。
报告撰写风格的优化弱于信息检索与综合。
